metadata.purpose: Map drawing only. Not used for pathfinding costs.
metadata.status: ESTIMATED. Road paths inferred from coarse stop coordinates, not surveyed jeepney paths. Verify or remove before the final defense.
metadata.source: OSRM public demo server (router.project-osrm.org), road data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
metadata.method: OSRM map matching per jeepney route (stops in order, 25 m tolerance per stop, sent in pieces of at most 10 stops), split into one path per hop. Hops without a match reuse mapasahe_edge_geometry_v1.json when available.

status_values.osrm_route_fallback: path from the first attempt, hop by hop (drawn)
status_values.kept_straight_detour: path saved but judged too long a detour (straight line drawn)

metadata.rejection_rule: kept_straight_detour when road distance is more than 3x the straight-line distance and more than 300 m longer than it.
